name: Shiraishi Ririsa
source:
Although she appears free-spirited, she is a serious and caring senior.

A third-year student in the performing arts department at Minomori Private Academy.
Both of her parents are famous painters, and Ririsa has been traveling around the world all year round since she was a child.
Because of this, she has very few memories of interacting with her parents.

She is easygoing and good at getting close to people, and can usually get along with people she meets for the first time.
On the other hand, she always keeps a certain distance, and there are very few people she interacts with in her private life.
Although she is easygoing, she is a reliable person who is very observant. She often enjoys paying attention to Kasumi.

After being scouted, she started modeling, but in reality, it doesn't feel right.

She is good at painting, but recently she has been interested in three-dimensional sculpture.
In the drama club, she is mainly in charge of art-related activities.

There are things she is grateful to Yuino, and even though she is younger, she respects her.
She feels that she has something in common with Ikumi, and is concerned about her.
